question: In relation to congenital hypothyroidism, indicate the statement FALSE:

options.opa: Neonatal screening programs detect most cases.
options.opb: A non-majority percentage of cases (around 10%) are transitory.
options.opc: Thyroid dyshormonogenesis are the most frequent causes.
options.opd: Thyroid dysgenesis are alterations in the embryonic development of the thyroid gland.

analysis: Congenital hypothyroidism is a condition that affects infants from birth due to a deficiency of thyroid hormone. Neonatal screening programs are effective in detecting most cases of congenital hypothyroidism. Thyroid dysgenesis, not thyroid dyshormonogenesis, are the most frequent causes of congenital hypothyroidism. Thyroid dysgenesis refers to alterations in the embryonic development of the thyroid gland.
